title: The Truth About Ai Recruitment That Every Job Seeker Should Know
caption:
Has this ever happened to you? You spend hours perfecting an application, only to get an automated rejection within hours.

Here is what really happens with ai recruitment in modern hiring pipelines. Have you experienced this in your job search? Share your thoughts below!
cta: Have you noticed this in your job search? Let us know in the comments below!
